text:
This notice should be read with:

Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Minimum Requirements for seafarers etc.) Regulations 2014

Regulation 3.1 of the Maritime Labour Convention (MLC), 2006

MGN 481 (M) Amendment 1 MLC, 2006: crew accommodation supplementary guidance

It replaces MSN 1844 (M) MLC, 2006: crew accommodation.

Amendment 1 updates reference information only.

Notice to:

shipowners

ship operators

ship managers

employers of seafarers

masters

officers

seafarers on seagoing ships ordinarily engaged in commercial operations

ship builders

yacht builders
